title: 第5章 莫欺老年穷第6章 漫天风雪送一人
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 【第二十三年，四十岁。
【一名魔道武者闯入白云县，他手持一面黑气腾腾的幡旗，见人就杀。
【县里的武者和官差，都不是他的对手，统统被他杀死，灵魂收入幡中。
【斩妖司的斩妖使被惊动，与他大战数日，终是拼着同归于尽，将他重伤。
【魔道武者遁走的时候，顺手杀了你的女儿，取走了她全部的精血。
【老板娘悲痛交加，一病不起，含恨离世。
【你先葬女儿，后葬妻子。
【一想到女儿才七岁，几天前还虎头虎脑的喊着“爹爹”
，再想到她死时的惨状。
【你心如刀割，夜夜惊醒。
【可是你还有儿子，你知道你不能倒下。
【第三十三年，五十岁。
【南疆出了一位惊才绝艳的女帝，她整合南疆各国，将零散的南疆百国拧成了一股绳，反攻中原。
【战线一路从南向北推进，白云县眼看就要沦为前线。
【你的儿子决定奔赴战场，保家卫国。
【“儿啊，能不去吗？战场太危险了……”
【“父亲，国之不存，家欲何为！
您从小就喜欢对外人说‘我陈东的儿子将来定有出息’，如今到我建功立业的时候了！”
【你送儿出城，目送他远行。
【这一刻，你似乎一下子老了很多。
content_en:
[Twenty-three years, forty years old.
[A demonic warrior broke into Baiyun County. He held a black flag and killed everyone on sight.
[The warriors and officials in the county were no match for him. They were all killed by him and their souls were collected in the flags.
[The demon slayers of the Demon Slayer Division were alerted and fought with him for several days. Finally, they fought to the death together and seriously injured him.
[When the demonic warrior escaped, he killed your daughter and took away all her blood essence.
[The landlady was so sad that she fell ill and passed away with regret.
[You bury your daughter first, then your wife.
[When I think about my daughter who is only seven years old, she was shouting "Daddy" in a futile manner just a few days ago.
, and then thought of the tragic situation when she died.
【Your heart is like a knife, and you wake up every night.
[But you still have a son, so you know you can’t fall.
[Thirty-three years, fifty years old.
[A stunningly talented and beautiful empress emerged from Southern Xinjiang. She integrated all the countries in Southern Xinjiang, twisted the scattered countries in Southern Xinjiang into a rope, and counterattacked the Central Plains.
[The battle line is advancing from south to north, and Baiyun County is about to become the front line.
[Your son decided to go to the battlefield to protect his family and country.
["Son, can you not go? The battlefield is too dangerous..."
["Father, if the country does not exist, what will the family want to do!"
Since you were a child, you have liked to tell outsiders, ‘My Chen Dong’s son will definitely have a bright future.’ Now it’s time for me to make a contribution! "
[You send your son out of the city and watch him travel far away.
[At this moment, you seem to have aged a lot.
title_en: Chapter 5: Don’t bully the old and poor Chapter 6: The wind and snow send someone away
